Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Gudger
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/03/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 79 as introduced would increase the expenditures of the Employees' Retirement System (ERS) Expense Fund by approximately $1,222 to $2,444 annually for travel expenses for the two new ERS board members positions established by this bill. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
